Advanced Practices in
Voice & Dysphagia
February 17-20, 2027
Wednesday, February 17, 2027
Join us for the Sin City Voice Symposium Wednesday, February 17, 2027 for a full-day program designed specifically for speech-language pathologists seeking to advance their clinical expertise in voice and swallowing evaluation and rehabilitation. Through expert presentations, interactive discussions, and case-based learning, participants will gain practical strategies for assessing and treating a wide range of voice disorders, including essential vocal tremor, laryngeal dystonia, head and neck cancerârelated voice and swallowing disorders, and the performing voice.
As our understanding of voice and swallowing disorders and rehabilitation continues to evolve, clinicians must move beyond a "recipe-based" approach to therapy and develop stronger clinical reasoning to individualize treatment. This course emphasizes evidence-based decision-making, demonstrations of effective therapy techniques, and interactive case discussions that participants can immediately apply in clinical practice. Whatever your work setting, this course offers practical tools and expert insights to enhance your confidence and improve patient outcomes. We look forward to welcoming you to Las Vegas!
The cost for the voice symposium is a separate registration fee from the main conference:
$155* for SLPs and other practitioners also attending the main Laryngology conference
$115* for SLP Masters students also attending the main Laryngology conference
$180* for SLPs and other practitioners attending only the Voice Symposium
$135* for SLP Masters students attending only the Voice Symposium
*After Jan 11, 2027, add $20
